widget.title: 🔄 Change From Usual
widget.label: 🔄 Is this different from your usual period experience?
options: No, this is normal for me

why_this_widget_matters.title: Why this widget matters
why_this_widget_matters.description: The app should distinguish between what is normal for the individual user and what is a new or unusual change.

widget.supporting_text: Choose the option that best describes how this experience compares with your usual period experience.
widget.professional_design_rule: Use this response to understand the user's reported change from their usual experience. Do not treat the selection as a diagnosis or medical risk score.
